tagline: International Association for Inland Navigation Representing Shipping, Insurance and Survey
hero_kpi_rationale: IVR is a non-profit association with no commercial activity; no specific financial KPIs could be extracted from the source.

kpis.name: Annual Congress Attendance
kpis.explanation: Number of attendees at the IVR annual congress held in Frankfurt from May 15 to 17, 2024.
kpis.description: Indicator of the association's engagement and influence among its members and partners at the annual congress.

kpis.name: Number of Countries Represented at Congress
kpis.explanation: Number of European countries represented at the IVR 2024 annual congress.
kpis.description: Indicator of the association's pan-European representation in the inland navigation sector, demonstrating its international influence.

kpis.name: Loss Prevention Colloquium Attendance
kpis.explanation: Number of participants at the first IVR Loss Prevention Colloquium held in Antwerp on November 4, 2024.
kpis.description: First edition of the annual Loss Prevention Colloquium, a major new initiative by the association to promote the sharing of technical and financial knowledge on incident prevention in European inland navigation.

kpis.name: Number of Members
kpis.explanation: Total number of members in the IVR association representing the interests of European inland navigation.
kpis.description: Indicator of the association's representativeness and size at the pan-European level within the inland navigation sector.
kpis.signal: Size and reach of the association
